{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the revenue column for formatting
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique())

# Check if any values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check if all revenue values are valid numbers after cleaning
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Convert to float
sales['revenue_float'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue_clean'], errors='coerce')

# Check for invalid conversions
invalid_count = sales['revenue_float'].isna().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of invalid revenue conversions: {invalid_count}")"}
